weeks.summary: Your network pulled in 412 visits across 530 pageviews this week, with GoCheckMyCrypto leading the pack at 86 visits and notably high engagement at 145 pageviews, while GoCheckMy and GoCheckMyParents tied for second at 68 visits each. GoCheckMyPet showed strong internal engagement with 31 visits generating 78 pageviews, suggesting visitors are exploring multiple pages on that site, whereas GoCheckMyHome and GoCheckMyMortgage lagged at 24 visits each with minimal additional pageviews.

Overall traffic dipped 35% week-over-week to 269 visits, with gocheckmy.com dropping sharply from 68 to 16 visits and gocheckmyestate.com falling from 51 to 9. The brighter spots were gocheckmysports.com and gocheckmynews.com, which both entered the data this week with 43 and 31 visits respectively, while gocheckmyparents.com and gocheckmycrypto.com remained your strongest performers with 35 and 42 visits despite modest declines.
